$comment: The bake-off matrix. A CELL is one (harness, model) pair — the unit this platform runs, scores and compares. Harness = the agent loop; model = an endpoint + model id + key. Both axes vary independently, which is the point: 'which model is better' is not answerable without holding the harness fixed, and vice versa. The container reads its model config from os/api/wrangler.toml [vars]; THIS file is the source of truth for the GitHub Actions runner, which has no worker to ask. bakeoff/bakeoff.selftest.mjs asserts the two agree on model ids so they cannot drift apart silently.

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.$comment: Speaks the Anthropic Messages API, so it drives any provider offering an Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Model tiers are all pinned to one id — see os/api/container/agent.sh.

opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.$comment: Provider-agnostic through the Vercel AI SDK; we register each model as a custom @ai-sdk/openai-compatible provider against the provider's OpenAI-shaped endpoint. A genuinely different agent loop and system prompt, which is what makes the harness axis worth having.

$cells_comment: Every (harness, model) combination that should run. A cell whose keyEnv secret is absent from the repo is SKIPPED with a notice, not failed — a bake-off missing one provider is still a bake-off, and a red X on a missing key teaches nothing. 'reference' cells are scored and shown but excluded from the ranking: they are the control, not a contestant.
